cohort: Nearly 26,000 women who gave birth in the French Centre-Val de Loire region in 2016.
finding: In 2016, the cesarean section rate in the Centre-Val de Loire region was 19.2% (7.0% planned), with planned rates being higher for breech presentation and scarred uterus, decreasing with higher maternity levels, and 32% of studied planned cesarean sections being potentially avoidable.
mod_finding: The study revealed that 19.2% of births were by cesarean section, 7.0% of which were planned, and 32% of these planned cesarean sections were identified as potentially avoidable, often due to isolated indications like a single previous cesarean or breech presentation.
cross-section timing: Data from the 2016 regional birth register, supplemented by a survey conducted from September 2016 to February 2017.
